_meta.note: PROVISIONAL — CANONICAL BRANCHING DEMO RUN (KAN-4 run engine, decision log #31; wave 3c added the mid room; KAN-5 wave 4b grows the linear list into a ROOM GRAPH — rules-addendum R29). The authored demo run the RunState engine consumes verbatim: Brood Landing (entry room, index 0) is the tutorial-floor brood skirmish where the party meets Sasha (staged as a party-side ally NPC — decision #31's staging default: the recruit FIGHTS the offer encounter, and joining AS-IS carries that damage). Clearing it opens the run's FIRST EXPLORATION BEAT — a two-way branch (the §4.6 maze funnel's texture, authored as data): (a) the KENNEL GAUNTLET — the war-hound pair (data/enemies.json war_hound: compendium §4.6's maze hounds, PROVISIONAL owner review) staged as the pack it is authored to be; or (b) the SERVICE CORRIDOR — the crew's maintenance route, a lighter fight reusing the roach mob template (two roach-dogs in a narrow corridor). BOTH routes exit into the Incine-Dile den (single exits — auto-advance, no beat), and the den is the TERMINAL room: clearing it wins the run (graph WIN — no end_run needed). The graph is a DAG (v1 ruling: revisitable defaults false, no loops; validated by scripts/validate_seeds.py — exits resolve, terminal exists, no cycles, all rooms reachable). HYPE CHAIN FULLY LIVE (decision #32 ladder, CHAIN_RETENTION_PCT) and UNTOUCHED by exploration beats (back-to-back glue, not a rest — R29): whichever branch is chosen opens at floor(40% x Brood Landing's ending meter) and the den at floor(60% x the mid room's ending meter) — pinned by tests/test_run_state.gd + tests/test_dungeon_flow.gd. RECRUIT PICK — Sasha 'The Tell' over Nikita, three reasons: (1) party gap — Imani tanks on Physique 5, Dario tricks on Reflexes/Charm 5/5, nobody fields Mind; Sasha's Mind 5 is the only spread that adds a new axis to the demo pair (her own file's stated role). (2) Kit safety vs the slice boss — the Incine-Dile is Mind 1, so her feints can never be read (R24), while Nikita's bruiser kit duplicates Imani's Force role. (3) Frame fit — a casino floor manager who counted cards on her own abductors is the Cosmic Casino slice's most on-theme first recruit. Nikita stays reserved for a later den. MID-ROOM PICK — the war-hound pair: a pack-hunting Elite pair exercises a tier the slice lacked (R15 pack synergy above mob tier — a lone hound is Robustness-blocked by the tank, the linked pair bites through) and its bleeding attrition feeds the run's wounds-persist hand-offs; the SERVICE CORRIDOR is the deliberate soft route (mob-tier reuse, no new content) so the branch is a real risk/reward choice. All numbers PLACEHOLDER (R14); every spec below is copied VERBATIM from its loadout source and drift-gated by tests/test_run_state.gd (test_demo_run_data_contract). WAVE 3d (KAN-5 arenas): every encounter carries an authored 'arena' block (bounds; the den also walls + trash cans — PLACEHOLDER positions, PROVISIONAL until the owner redesigns rooms with the front). WAVE 4b (KAN-5 doors): the den's arena authors two DOORS (PLACEHOLDER positions, PROVISIONAL — the owner redesigns rooms with the front): the closed service hatch (the corridor route's sealed crew entrance — opening it is the R3 free-action door command) and the open kennel gate. A closed door blocks exactly like a wall (one blocking query — movement, dash lanes, bounces); enemies never open doors in v1. Arena defs LIVE HERE on the encounter def (documented decision, simulation/arena.gd header); RunState.staging() passes the block through and GameController stages set_arena before the add batch.

arena._note: KAN-5 wave 3d PROVISIONAL: a tighter kennel (11x11 axial rect centered on the staging origin, q/r in [-5, 5]). WAVE 4d TOUCH-UP (PROVISIONAL like everything here — the owner redesigns rooms with the front): the kennel-run fence (a west-side wall line with ONE gap) + the OPEN kennel-run gate in that gap — the obvious escape back up the run, and exactly what the second hound's corner_the_prey cut-off denies (R11 #21: the herder pack chases prey toward the gate and posts a hound ON it). Fence and gate sit clear of every staged spawn (q >= 0) and of the scripted fight around the origin, so the drive's staging is untouched; they exist so the funnel is REAL in the authored room, not only in tests. K2 TERRAIN (R33, PLACEHOLDER positions, PROVISIONAL): the kennel-muck patch — a difficult-terrain row along the south pens (r = 3), the first authored terrain in the game. It bills movement 2 per hex (R14 placeholder cost) through the terrain-weighted AI pathing; it sits clear of every spawn, the fence and the gate funnel, so the staged fight and the drive are untouched.

arena._note: KAN-5 wave 4b PROVISIONAL: the deliberate soft route — a narrow maintenance corridor (15x5 axial rect centered on the staging origin, q in [-7, 7], r in [-2, 2]) with a lighter roach pair (mob-template reuse, no new content). No walls, no objects. The owner will redesign rooms with the front. K2 LOCK (R33, PLACEHOLDER position, PROVISIONAL): the supply cage — the crew's locked storage hatch at the corridor's far end, the first authored LOCKED door (tier simple, R14 placeholder tier table). It opens onto nothing yet (flavor + the lockpicking skill's future practice target); the door command rejects it door_locked, and only the pick path (the lockpicking skill, next story) opens it. Clear of every spawn and the scripted fight around the origin.

KAN-5 wave 3d: the den's authored 41x60 bounds mirror the incinedile's traits.arena_hexes [41, 60] design record (axial rect centered on the staging origin: q in [-20, 20], r in [-30, 29]). Walls + trash cans are PLACEHOLDER positions at the room's edges (deliberately clear of the staging cluster) — the owner will redesign rooms with the front. The cans are live phase-3 fuel: flamethrower sweeps accumulate Burn on them, 5 explodes (3 spaces, 2 Burn), phase 3+ pops instantly. WAVE 4b DOORS (R29, PLACEHOLDER positions, PROVISIONAL): the terminal room is the graph's convergence point, so it authors both flavors — the CLOSED service hatch (the corridor route's sealed crew entrance: blocks exactly like a wall until a contestant opens it with the free-action door command; enemies never open doors v1) and the OPEN kennel gate (blocks nothing — the hounds' route stands open). Both sit clear of walls, cans and every staged spawn (validator-gated).
